tei:div.tei:p: Thou art the Lord our God, in heaven and on earth and in the highest heaven. In truth Thou art the first and Thou art the last and besides Thee there is no God. Gather those who hope for Thee from the four corners of the earth, so that all who come into the world may recognize and know that Thou alone art God over all realms of the earth. Thou hasThou hast made heavens and earth, the sea and everything within them, and who is there among all the work of Thy hands, higher or lower who might say to Thee: What art Thou doing? Our Father in Heaven, show us grace for Thy Great Name’s sake, that is called upon us, and fulfil for us, O Lord our God, what is written: at that time I shall bring you, at the time when I gather you. Then will I give you name and fame among all the peoples of the earth, when I lead back your captivities in front of your eyes, says the Lord.
